exercise-start.title: An exercise, just opened
exercise-start.job: Someone who has just opened an exercise can tell how to start it, how long it runs, and how to record themselves to listen back.

A.caption: Empezar starts the exercise with the microphone. Recording yourself is an option among the settings; on phones it is not shown.

B.caption: Empezar starts the exercise with the microphone. '⏺ Grabarme', ticked before Empezar, also records the session to listen back in Historial.

exercise-pitch.title: A pitch exercise, before singing
exercise-pitch.job: A learner on a pitch-matching exercise understands what the screen will tell them about their singing and what to do first.

A.caption: Empezar plays the note and listens. The numbers above the lane fill in while the learner sings.

B.caption: Empezar plays the note and listens. The readout above the lane fills in while the learner sings: whether they are on the note and which way to move.

exercise-timeup.title: An exercise when its time runs out
exercise-timeup.job: A learner whose exercise timer has just reached zero knows the exercise is over and what to do next.

A.caption: When the time reaches 0:00 the exercise stops and asks how it went; answering saves the session.

B.caption: When the time reaches 0:00 the exercise stops and asks how it went; answering saves the session. The start button repeats the exercise.

exercise-piano.title: The exercise's piano options
exercise-piano.job: A learner who opens the piano options understands each one and can change what they need.

A.caption: The piano button opens options: play the notes automatically, sustain them, and fit the exercise to the learner's range.

B.caption: The piano button opens options: play the notes automatically, sustain them, and fit the exercise to the learner's range.

exercise-speaking.title: A speaking exercise, just opened
exercise-speaking.job: Someone practising their speaking voice can tell how to start this exercise and what it asks of them.

A.caption: Empezar starts the exercise with the microphone.

B.caption: Empezar starts the exercise with the microphone. '⏺ Grabarme' also records the session.
